notes: Each sheet = frames side by side, frame_width x frame_height each. anchor = [x,y] pixel inside a frame. *_glow.png = same layout, only the emissive pixels (use for additive/bloom overlay).

sprites.name: angelfish
sprites.notes: Tall silver body, trailing dorsal/anal fins, 3 slanted ink bars, gold face. Fin tips flutter. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: clownfish
sprites.notes: Orange body, 3 white bands with ink edging. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: tuna
sprites.notes: Fast open-water swimmer; lunate tail, gold flank stripe, yellow finlets. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: pufferfish
sprites.notes: Relaxed (deflated) puffer, spotted back. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: pufferfish_inflated
sprites.notes: Inflated puffer with 2px spikes (defence pose). 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: seahorse
sprites.notes: Vertical pose, curled tail sways, dorsal fin ripples. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: jellyfish
sprites.notes: Bell pulses, tentacles trail; glow pixels on core + tentacles (see _glow sheet). 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: squid
sprites.notes: Arms/head point right, mantle with fins trails left; jet pulse. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: manta_ray
sprites.notes: Top-down 3/4 view, wing span flaps (foreshortens); white shoulder patches. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: lanternfish
sprites.notes: Photophore row pulses through 4 cyan tones (see _glow sheet). 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: anglerfish
sprites.notes: Bobbing glowing lure + dithered halo ring; fanged underbite (see _glow sheet). 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: school_sardine
sprites.notes: Small school fish, silver with blue back. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: school_yellow
sprites.notes: Small school fish, lemon yellow with dark bar. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: school_neon
sprites.notes: Small school fish, neon-tetra style. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: school_violet
sprites.notes: Small school fish, lavender anthias style with gold fins. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: school_minnow
sprites.notes: Tiniest school fish, slate with silver belly. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: blue_tang
sprites.notes: Royal-blue body, black palette marking, yellow tail + pectoral. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: sea_turtle
sprites.notes: Green shell with scute seams, front flipper flaps. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: reef_shark
sprites.notes: Grey reef shark; heterocercal tail, white belly, gill slits. 4-frame swim loop.

sprites.name: seagull_float
sprites.notes: Sitting on the water, wings folded; 2-frame head bob.

sprites.name: seagull_fly
sprites.notes: Wing flap: up, mid, down (loop 0,1,2,1 for a smooth flap).

sprites.name: seagull_dive
sprites.notes: Nose-down plunge dive, wings swept back; 2 frames of wing/tail jitter.

sprites.name: sloop_small
sprites.notes: Single-mast sloop; gaff mainsail + jib; jolly roger waves (3 frames). Anchor = hull centre at waterline; flag streams right.

sprites.name: sloop_large
sprites.notes: Larger sloop with crow's nest, gunports, jolly roger (3 frames). Anchor = hull centre at waterline; flag streams right.

sprites.name: galleon_small
sprites.notes: Three-masted galleon: square sails, lateen mizzen, stern castle, gunports; 3 flags wave. Anchor = hull centre at waterline; flag streams right.

sprites.name: galleon_large
sprites.notes: Large galleon, same layout at 1.7x with more detail. Anchor = hull centre at waterline; flag streams right.

sprites.name: kraken
sprites.notes: Front view; 8 curling tentacles with sucker rows; twin glowing eyes. Idle: tentacle sway + head bob + blink on frame 4. Eyes (and any glow pixels) also in _glow sheet. Rare spawn; 4-frame idle loop.

sprites.name: sea_serpent
sprites.notes: Side view, travelling body wave with dorsal spines and frill; jaw + glowing eye. Eyes (and any glow pixels) also in _glow sheet. Rare spawn; 4-frame idle loop.

sprites.name: leviathan
sprites.notes: Whale-like, dorsal spike ridge, throat pleats, toothed jaw; tail fluke sweep + fin flap. Eyes (and any glow pixels) also in _glow sheet. Rare spawn; 4-frame idle loop.

sprites.name: giant_squid
sprites.notes: Mantle trails left, huge eye, 8 arms + 2 club tentacles right; fin ripple + jet pulse. Eyes (and any glow pixels) also in _glow sheet. Rare spawn; 4-frame idle loop.

sprites.name: megalodon
sprites.notes: Giant shark: gill slits, big dorsal, toothy jaw opening, heterocercal tail sweep. Eyes (and any glow pixels) also in _glow sheet. Rare spawn; 4-frame idle loop.
